title: Meet Your Marketing Team | Vertical Studios
description: Meet the Vertical Studios team: our studio manager, a creative director with 25+ years of experience, leadership and apprentices from Vertical Immersive.

blocks.headline: Meet your team
blocks.body: Senior marketers lead. Apprentices from Vertical Immersive produce. Here are the people behind your marketing, starting with the two you'll talk to most.

blocks.heading: Who you'll work with day to day
blocks.body: Gabe keeps your projects moving. Jen makes sure the work is right.

items.title: Gabe Wheeler
items.body: Gabe leads the studio team and is your day-to-day bridge to Studios. His engineering background makes him a creative problem solver and systems thinker.

items.title: Jen Fox
items.body: Jen holds our work to your marketing goals and our standard for quality. A former mid-size agency owner with 25+ years of experience, she also teaches visual communications at Vertical Immersive.

blocks.heading: Leadership
blocks.body: The leaders who set direction for Studios and keep it aligned with our mission.

items.title: Brian Wheeler
items.body: Brian is a Kingdom entrepreneur who leads service companies, including a wealth management firm and a wedding venue. As the voice of the client, he helps our team understand what you want to achieve.

items.title: Susan Rozzi
items.body: Susan sets the strategic direction for Studios, drives growth and nurtures partnerships. She keeps every part of the organization aligned with our mission, values and standard of excellence.

items.title: Kaitlyn Smith
items.body: Kaitlyn oversees workflows, resources, financial stewardship and team performance. She partners with Susan to turn vision into a strategy the team can execute.

blocks.heading: The production crew
blocks.body: Our crew comes from Vertical Immersive, a faith-focused higher education program. They produce your work under direct supervision.

items.title: Noah Bales
items.body: Noah turns the creative vision into video, from shoot prep and on-set work to post-production editing. He's a Vertical Immersive alumnus.

items.title: Carson Poore
items.body: From back-end systems to branding and messaging, Carson jumps on anything and does it with excellence. He's a second-year student at Vertical Immersive.

items.title: Alea Fleck
items.body: Alea runs social media for our clients, creating and posting content that resonates with audiences. Alea is a second-year student at Vertical Immersive.

blocks.heading: Talk with Gabe
blocks.body: Every engagement starts with a short call. Tell us about your organization and what winning looks like for you this year.
